nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠On January 17, 2025, the #Pernambuco State Health Department confirmed two cases of human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) infections, marking the first in the state this year. 
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The cases involved two young girls, aged 1 year and 7 months and 3 years and 11 months, from Recife and Jaboatão dos Guararapes. 
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Both patients, initially exhibiting fever, cough, respiratory discomfort, and diarrhea, have since been discharged from hospital care. 
The samples were analyzed by Pernambuco's Central Public Health Laboratory (#Lacen-PE). 
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Despite global concerns following an uptick in #HMPV cases in #China, the World Health Organization reported no unusual outbreaks or overburdened healthcare systems. 
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠#HMPV, a respiratory-transmitted virus with a 20-year history in #Brazil, had 27 cases recorded in #Pernambuco as recently as 2022.
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Pernambuco's first 2025 #HMPV cases highlight localized detections without broader outbreak signals. 
Both patients recovered successfully, indicating manageable healthcare impact.
#hMPV #outbreak #Brazil #WHO
